intent: LazyKeys 从启动受管 Neovim 到复制或确认执行命令的四步操作流程图

canvas.background: deep warm charcoal with restrained sage illumination

art_direction.description: Four precise keycaps connected by quiet directional strokes, with clear editorial typography and restrained hand-drawn accents
art_direction.rendering: editable vector illustration with dimensional keycap materials
art_direction.material: matte charcoal keycaps, sage accents, subtle blue secondary cues
art_direction.detail: titles and shortcut labels remain legible at README width

elements.role: first action: install and launch the managed Neovim profile
second action: type a prefix such as leader and allow context to appear
third action: open Chinese command search with Control Option K
fourth action: copy keys or execute after reading the risk confirmation
sparse hand-drawn underline and small registration marks reinforcing the flow

constraints: Keep the four steps in the actual product workflow order
Do not repeat the mascot or main logo
Use one light direction and the existing sage and blue palette
Keep text live and editable, with Avenir Next for titles and SF Mono for shortcuts
Keep the plain-text quick start in README as the accessible alternative
assumptions: The illustration supplements rather than replaces the existing numbered instructions
